title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-controls-util-reporting-fix
author: Alex Kim
release_notes: Fix autoscaler burst token bucket edgecases that caused incorrect burst credit accounting under simultaneous scale-up events; smoother tokenbucket smoothing added and utilization reporting corrected for short-lived nodes.
description: Motivation: sporadic utilization spikes and concurrent scale-ups could lead to negative burst credit and inconsistent utilization metrics in Dedicated fleets. This PR fixes token-bucket smoothing edgecases, improves the burst recovery path during scale events, and corrects a reporting bug that underreported short-lived node utilization in fleet dashboards. Changes include a safer smoothing algorithm, guards to prevent double-deducting burst credits during overlapping allocations, and a fix to the utilization rollup to include preempted node samples within the aggregation window. Includes unit and integration tests and updated docs and migration notes.
